format.line: {name, request: {method, path, headers, body}, response: {status, headers, body}}
format.body: parsed JSON if the text is JSON, else the raw text; "" = empty response body; null = no request body
format.headers: response headers without Date; Content-Length is that of the original (not normalised) body

normalisation.hex64: <kind:N> per kind (tx, block, spendkey, spendpub, viewkey, txkey, txpub, hex), numbered by first appearance
normalisation.shape: names ending in ~shape: every number in the response body is <n>
